pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Shiva iconography / temple art

patterns: PYQs are direct single-fact items: author of a work (Prem Vatika = Raskhan), guru-disciple (Daya Bai - Charandas), number (navadha bhakti = 9).
Origin questions: movement started by the Alvars; Nathpanthis/Siddhas popularised devotion in Northern India.
Women saints and their compositions appear as match-the-pair items.
APPSC tilt: Nirguna saint = Kabir; Siddhacharya trap (Udbhata); Andhra figures (Palnati Brahmanayudu, Vemana, Palkuriki Somanatha).
App leans heavily on 3-statement and interpretive items (scholarly debate, significance) that the exam rarely uses.
